description: This Java source file defines the class 'ResumeSource', which provides a fault-tolerant, exponential backoff stream source for Akka Streams. It manages stream resumption after errors using seeds, backoff strategies, and seed generation based on past elements. It includes builder methods, internal classes for stream control, error handling, and backoff logic.

classes.name: ResumeSource
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to create fault-tolerant sources with resumption capabilities using exponential backoff.

classes.name: Envelope
classes.description: Internal interface representing stream elements, errors, or end-of-stream signals.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Implementation of Envelope, representing a regular stream element.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Implementation of Envelope, representing an error in the stream.

classes.name: EndOfStream
classes.description: Implementation of Envelope, signifying the end of the stream.

classes.name: FailureWithLookBehind
classes.description: Container holding final elements before failure and the associated Throwable, used for seed generation.

classes.name: NeverCancelFlow
classes.description: A custom Akka Streams GraphStage that never cancels upstream, used to control termination order in feedback loops.

classes.name: EndStreamOnEOS
classes.description: GraphStage that completes the stream upon receiving an EndOfStream marker.

classes.name: StatefulBackoffFunction
classes.description: Function to produce delay durations using exponential backoff, resetting after recovery.

classes.name: StatefulLookBehindFunction
classes.description: Function that maintains a look-behind window of elements and produces errors with context.
